description: This file defines a simple memory page allocator class 'PageAllocator' and related utilities for managing memory pages directly from the kernel, intended for use in scenarios where heap integrity may be compromised. It includes platform-specific mmap wrappers, a custom allocator for STL containers, and a wasteful vector implementation that allocates memory from the page allocator.

classes.name: PageAllocator
classes.description: A simple allocator that fetches pages directly from the kernel, with no free operation, used for low-level memory management.

classes.name: PageStdAllocator
classes.description: A STL allocator wrapper that allocates memory from a PageAllocator.

classes.name: wasteful_vector
classes.description: A std::vector variant that allocates memory from a PageAllocator, resizing always allocates a new array.

methods.name: Alloc
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of specified size from the page allocator.

methods.name: OwnsPointer
methods.description: Checks if the page allocator owns a given pointer.

methods.name: GetNPages
methods.description: Allocates a specified number of pages from the kernel using mmap.
